name: Ralph Lauren
outlook:
What Ralph Lauren says to expect

  • Full year fiscal 2027: constant currency revenueFor Fiscal 2027, the Company expects constant currency revenues to increase mid- to high-single digits to last year on a 52-week comparable basis, now centered around 6% to 7%, up from a range of 5% to 6% previously, reflecting better-than-expected second quarter results. Based on current exchange rates, foreign currency is now expected to negatively impact revenue growth by approximately 40 to 60 basis points in Fiscal 2027.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: revenueFor the third quarter, the Company expects revenues to grow approximately low- to mid-single digits on a constant currency basis, centered around 3% to 4%. This outlook includes approximately 1 point of negative impact from wholesale timing shifts and strategic off-price reductions in the quarter . Foreign currency is expected to negatively impact revenue growth by approximately 50 to 100 basis points.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: operating marginOperating margin for the third quarter is expected to expand approximately 50 to 70 basis points in constant currency, with gross margin expansion more than offsetting higher marketing investments in the holiday period. Foreign currency is expected to benefit gross margin by about 20 to 40 basis points and have a roughly neutral to 20 basis point benefit to operating margin in the quarter.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: tax rateThe Company's full year Fiscal 2027 tax rate is still expected to be in the range of approximately 21% to 22%. The third quarter tax rate is expected to be approximately 23% to 24%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
